'''Granz Niiliisi''' was a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] and the head of the [[Massa Family]] based on [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]]. He owned [[Lot 452]], but was attacked and driven off-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] by [[ThunderForce]], who were hired by one of his rivals.<ref name="H&S" />

==Personality and traits==
Niiliisi was known for his temper and strong will. He liked expensive [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]] and [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="H&S" />
